title: 第3章第4章 试探第5章 动手
content_zh:
徐长生深吸一口气，强行让自己镇定下来。
匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。
这个道理，他懂。
若是小青葫的秘密泄露出去，莫说姜老大，便是那些高高在上的筑基修士、金丹真人，恐怕都会出手抢夺。
“小青葫，你放心，从今往后，你就是我最大的秘密。”
徐长生低声喃喃，将小青葫紧紧攥在手中，贴肉藏好。
他没有立刻服用极品聚气丹，而是先完成了当日的浇水任务。
直到夜深人静，同院的杂役弟子都已睡下，徐长生才悄悄盘膝坐在床上，取出一颗极品聚气丹，放入口中。
丹药入腹，顿时化作一股温热的气流，顺着经脉四散开来。
徐长生不敢怠慢，立刻运转《长春功》。
这是清虚宗外门弟子修行的基础功法，虽不入流，却是他唯一会的修行法门。
灵气在经脉中奔涌，远比平日吸纳天地灵气的速度快了百倍不止！
丹田之内，原本只有稀薄的一层灵气，此刻却如同溪流汇入，渐渐充盈起来。
练气一层，本就是筑基之始，丹田如碗，灵气如水。
五行灵根修行缓慢，便是因为这“碗”需要五种灵气同时填满，方能破境。
然而此刻，极品聚气丹所提供的精纯灵气，如同浩荡江河，瞬间填满徐长生的筋脉，向他的丹田汇聚而去。
徐长生只觉得丹田内金、木、水、火、土五色灵气轮转，竟隐隐有了一种奇妙的平衡。
转眼间，练气二层，突破！
不止如此，丹药释放出来的药力，未见丝毫枯竭，仍旧持续不断涌入。
浩浩荡荡，如无尽头。

练气三层，突破！
清冷的月辉透过窗棂照进来，徐长生缓缓睁开双眼。
他的眼中，精光一闪而逝。
“练气三层！”
徐长生握紧拳头，感受着体内远比昨日雄浑了数倍的灵气，心头涌起一股前所未有的激动。
五行灵根修行之难，天下皆知。
苦修多年，他依然止步于练气一层，却没想到，服下一颗极品聚气丹后，却从练气一层，一跃迈入练气三层！
而且，他能感受到，有一层似有似无的屏障，阻拦在丹田之中。
那便是突破至练气中期的屏障，只要打破屏障，他就能一跃踏入练气四层！
“若是一直有极品聚气丹供应，我的修行速度，未必比那些单灵根慢！”
徐长生取出小青葫，看着这个外表毫不起眼的小葫芦，目光炽热。
“你究竟是什么来历？”
徐长生将小青葫捧在掌心，试着探入一丝灵识。
练气三层，灵识衍生，既可以内视自身，也可以外放。
下一刻，异变陡生！
小青葫表面那圈淡青色的圆环骤然亮起，一股柔和的吸力传来，徐长生只觉眼前一花，灵识竟进入了一片灰蒙蒙的空间。
这空间不大，约莫三丈方圆，四周皆是混沌雾气，看不真切。
一道信息涌入他的脑海。
“混沌青葫，先天灵根，可吸纳万物，演化生机。以灵气催动，可孕育丹药、灵植，有几率提升品阶。待葫中世界开辟，更可演化万物……”
徐长生目瞪口呆。

先天灵根？
content_en:
Xu Changsheng took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down.
The common man is not guilty, but he is guilty of carrying the jade.
He understands this.
If Xiao Qinghu's secret is leaked, not to mention Boss Jiang, but also those high-ranking foundation-building monks and Jindan Daoist, I'm afraid they will take action to snatch it away.
"Xiao Qinghu, don't worry, from now on, you will be my biggest secret."
Xu Changsheng murmured in a low voice, holding the little green gourd tightly in his hand and hiding it close to his flesh.
He did not take the ultimate Qi Gathering Pill immediately, but completed the watering task for the day first.
It wasn't until late at night, when all the handyman disciples in the same courtyard had gone to bed, that Xu Changsheng quietly sat cross-legged on the bed, took out a top-quality Qi Gathering Pill, and put it into his mouth.
When the elixir enters the abdomen, it immediately turns into a stream of warm air that spreads along the meridians.
Xu Changsheng did not dare to neglect and immediately activated the "Changchun Gong".
This is the basic technique practiced by the outer disciples of the Qingxu Sect. Although it is not popular, it is the only practice method he knows.
Spiritual energy surges through the meridians, a hundred times faster than the usual rate of absorbing spiritual energy from heaven and earth!
There was originally only a thin layer of spiritual energy in the dantian, but now it was like a stream flowing in, gradually filling it up.
The first level of Qi training is the beginning of foundation building. Dantian is like a bowl and spiritual energy is like water.
The reason why the cultivation of the Five Elements Spiritual Roots is slow is because the "bowl" needs to be filled with five kinds of spiritual energy at the same time in order to break through.
However, at this moment, the pure spiritual energy provided by the top quality Qi Gathering Pill was like a mighty river, instantly filling Xu Changsheng's veins and converging towards his Dantian.
Xu Changsheng only felt that the five colors of metal, wood, water, fire and earth in the Dantian were rotating, and there was a strange balance.
In the blink of an eye, I reached the second level of Qi training and achieved a breakthrough!
Not only that, the medicinal power released by the elixir has not been exhausted at all, and continues to flow in.
It's vast and endless.
Three levels of Qi training, breakthrough!
The cold moonlight shone in through the window lattice, and Xu Changsheng slowly opened his eyes.
There was a flash of light in his eyes.
"Third level of Qi training!"
Xu Changsheng clenched his fists, feeling the spiritual energy in his body that was several times more powerful than yesterday, and felt an unprecedented excitement in his heart.
Everyone knows how difficult it is to cultivate the Five Elements Spiritual Roots.
After years of hard training, he was still stuck at the first level of Qi training, but he never expected that after taking a top quality Qi gathering pill, he would jump from the first level of Qi training to the third level of Qi training!
Moreover, he could feel that there was a seemingly non-existent barrier blocking his dantian.
That is the barrier that breaks through to the middle stage of Qi training. As long as he breaks the barrier, he can leap into the fourth level of Qi training!
"If there is always a supply of top quality Qi Gathering Pills, my cultivation speed may not be slower than those with single spiritual roots!"
Xu Changsheng took out the small green gourd and looked at the unremarkable little gourd with fiery eyes.
"Where are you from?"
Xu Changsheng held the little green gourd in his palm and tried to detect a hint of spiritual consciousness.
At the third level of Qi training, spiritual consciousness is derived, which can be used to look inside oneself or outward.
The next moment, a sudden change occurred!
The light blue ring on the surface of the small green gourd suddenly lit up, and a soft suction force came. Xu Changsheng felt his eyes blur, and his spiritual consciousness entered a gray space.
This space is not big, about three feet in diameter, and is surrounded by chaotic mist, making it difficult to see clearly.
A piece of information flooded into his mind.
"Chaos green gourd, an innate spiritual root, can absorb all things and evolve vitality. Driven by spiritual energy, it can breed elixirs and spiritual plants, and has a chance of improving its grade. When the world in the gourd is opened, it can evolve all things..."
Xu Changsheng was stunned.
Innate spiritual roots?
